newsitem.title: USA: Rubin untroubled by reports Japan buys less bonds.
newsitem.headline: Rubin untroubled by reports Japan buys less bonds.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Thursday that he was not concerned about reports that Japanese investors are scaling back their purchases of U.S. Treasury bonds.
"I'm not the least bit troubled about it," he told a forum sponsored by the John F. Kennedy School.
He argued that the United States should not have trouble financing its debt "at a cost of capital that makes sense" if it continues to pursue responsible economic policies.
